description: Compresses verbose conversation history, logs, or codebase context by deduplicating repeated lines and, when `intent_focus` is provided, filtering to lines relevant to that intent. Token reduction is computed fresh per request from the actual input (highly variable — near-zero or even negative on already-short/unique input, higher on repetitive logs) — it is not a fixed guaranteed range. USE WHEN: context is large or repetitive and approaching a token budget; supply `intent_focus` for meaningfully better filtering — without it, only deduplication is applied. DO NOT USE WHEN: you need the content reasoned about (use rct_think) or expect true semantic summarization — this is line-level filtering, not an LLM rewrite, so it can drop details a summarizer would keep.

aggressive_mode.description: When true, strips conversational markers to retain only state changes.

intent_focus.description: Specific objective determining which state facts to preserve.

raw_context.description: Context text, dialogue transcript, or JSON context requiring compression.

name: compress_context

compressed_char_count.description: Character length of compressed delta representation.

context_hash.description: Cryptographic hash of the state transition.

estimated_compressed_tokens.description: Estimated token count of compressed state.

estimated_original_tokens.description: Estimated token count of original context.

reduction_percentage.description: Real computed token-saving percentage for this request (not clamped to a fixed range). Can be negative if the compression header overhead outweighs savings on already-short/unique input.
